physical_source_generation.state_definition: 0 is normalized scale start and 1 is normalized full scale; normalized 0 need not mean physical reading 0.

cost.accounting_note: Subprocess wall times include process startup and are not GPU kernel time or CPU core time. The initial failed preparation is counted separately. End-to-end time includes the stopped interval.

limitations: This stage changes state coverage in existing source scenes; it adds no background diversity.
The result records source data integrity and execution costs, not a model generalization result.
Single seed, four-epoch source-only continuation from externally selected feedback48; these viewed external datasets are development screens, not blind confirmation.

Endpoint data change state coverage in 128 existing scenes, with no added background diversity. New training contract intentionally differs from the anchor; all unselected rows and original validation remain unchanged.
Source best is selected only among four new epochs; the initialization itself remains a separate retained model.
BN-fixed epoch4 best/last is one identical checkpoint and external results are aliased; unique external compute counts exclude the alias.
Saved CPU arithmetic and execution metadata are checked; no new model load, inference, GPU computation, source GT composition or teacher test was run.
The published v7 source prediction table is historical context; this audit does not repeat its original execution audit.
